prompt:
Use case: identity-preserving compositing / app launcher artwork.
Edit the provided approved Goho family portrait into ONE compact SQUARE family grouping for a small app icon. Keep these exact THREE characters together: Bram on viewer LEFT in periwinkle lilac, Mira on RIGHT in rosy coral, their buttery-yellow little child front CENTER. Keep their exact friendly faces, glossy dark oval eyes with white highlights, soft smiles, matte fine clay texture and colors. Bram has exactly TWO ivory horns, NO curl, NO eyebrows. Mira has one integrated curl and eyebrows, NO horns. The child has one curl, eyebrows and TWO tiny ivory horn buds. Do not change these identities.
Arrange the family a little closer together for an icon, parents gently leaning inward behind the smaller child, recognizable substantial rounded arms and tiny feet. Keep faces large and readable. A compact rounded triangular family silhouette, roughly as tall as it is wide, all faces visible. The child stays smaller than the parents, occupying foreground lower center. Preserve the affectionate family portrait mood. Full characters or naturally overlapped bodies, no hard straight crop cutting a face or limb. No duplicated characters or body parts. Keep all curls, horns, arms and feet completely inside the image. Group centered with about 12% clear transparent margins. The entire family should remain legible when a launcher adds a circle around it. No outline, framing circle, badge or icon border in the artwork.
Genuinely TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, clean alpha edges. No floor, cast shadow, ground plane, text, names, accessories, receipts, hearts or extra objects. This is the family portrait adapted for a square icon, not a new character design.
